'''Lumbra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] criminal who worked for the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Haka Hai]] before betraying him.

==Biography==
Working for Hai while he was trading a crate from the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'', Lumbra decided to betray his boss and [[Skirmish on Mimban|steal]] the crate. But, unfortunately for him, the crate was actually a bomb. The moment one of his men opened it, it exploded, causing his [[Lumbra's ship|ship]] to crash-land on a habitable [[Unidentified jungle moon (K'Kruhk)|moon]]. Lumbra saw another ship, one that belong to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] and a group of younglings. He headed a team to salvage their ship and discovered the younglings' identity as Jedi. He shot [[Chase Piru]] when she tried to defend her friends, leaving her for dead, while towing the others to his ship.

However, Piru was revived by K'Kruhk and they set out a [[Skirmish on unidentified jungle moon|plan]] to rescue the younglings. One by one, Lumbra's men were killed by Piru's arrows. Lumbra soon held Piru hostage and demanded that K'Kruhk surrender. But the Jedi Master leapt forward and sliced Lumbra in half. The Jedi soon used his ship to travel elsewhere.
